decisions.reason: Unlimited duration and lack of expiration for coded-referral commissions do not change Small Block prize or ticket mechanics; the message's separate draw-condition statement is already represented.
The coded-referral commission limit and expiration do not alter the Big Block prize parameters, ticket rules, or winner selection.
The unlimited and non-expiring terms describe commissions earned when a referral code is used, not the existing allocation rule for mints without a code.
Commission limits and expiration do not change the referral code's source, permanence, ownership, or display locations.
The existing same-message MODIFY already states in process_referral_copy that qualifying referral commissions have no limits or expiration, so no addition or edit is required.
Message 156 revises the About page rather than the approved FAQ baseline, so the commission terms do not necessarily revise this candidate's current copy requirement.
Removing limits and expiration from coded-referral commissions does not change the per-mint commission amount or the primary-sale revenue allocation.
Commission limits and expiration do not change fiat-user authentication, dashboard access, or wallet requirements for receiving rewards.
The source Event changes coded-referral commission limits and expiration, not prize collection; the separate claim-versus-automatic question is already represented as ambiguity.
The coded-referral commission duration and limit do not alter secondary-sale royalties, their allocation, or whether secondary sales generate tickets.
Unlimited, non-expiring referral commissions do not change the transfer semantics of the book, referral code, badges, or prize tickets.
Commission limits and expiration do not change badge triggers, milestone thresholds, enablement, or award destination.
